en.description:
Make quick and fair decisions with just a swipe – now in Augmented Reality!

Heads or Tails brings classic coin flipping to a whole new level. Whether for everyday choices, game nights, or group decisions: The app delivers a 100% random result wrapped in a modern design.

WHAT AWAITS YOU:

COIN FLIP IN AR (AUGMENTED REALITY)
Toss your coin via the camera directly into your real environment and view 3D coins up close in your room.

MINIGAME: COIN PONG
Place virtual glasses on your real table and test your skills in AR Coin Pong – or play the minigame in classic mode without the camera.

CUSTOM COIN EDITOR
Design your own 3D coins with custom looks, details, and creative tools.

REALISTIC FEEL
Smooth animations, authentic sound effects, tactile haptic feedback, and an optional confetti effect for wins.

OVERVIEW & STATS
Keep track of all your flips with the built-in history and result counter.

MODERN DESIGN
Full support for Dark and Light Mode for comfortable use at any time of day.

Download Heads or Tails now and get the ultimate coin flip experience right on your phone!
en.releaseNotes:
New in 2.2.7

Choose your flip sound
• Three sounds to pick from: Classic, Metallic and Ringing Coin
• Find them under Settings → Flip Sound, tap to preview
• Your sound also plays on Apple Watch

Sounds like a real coin
• The sound follows your flick: a gentle flick sounds softer, a strong one brighter and louder
• No two flips sound exactly the same
en.subtitle: AR Coin Flip & Coin Pong Game

ja.trackName: コイントス - 表か裏か決めるアプリ
ja.description:
スワイプひとつで素早く公平な決断を – AR（拡張現実）機能が新登場！

《コイントス - 表か裏か決めるアプリ》は、クラシックなコイントスを次のレベルへと進化させます。友達との決め事、日常の迷い、パーティーでのゲームなど、どんな場面でも100%公平でランダムな結果を提供します。

主な特徴：

AR（拡張現実）モード
カメラ機能を使って、自分の部屋でリアルな3Dコインを投げ、細部までじっくり鑑賞できます。

ミニゲーム：コインポン（Coin Pong）
テーブルの上にカップを置いて狙いを定めるか、クラシックモードでいつでも手軽にプレイできます。

カスタムコインエディター
クリエイティビティを発揮しましょう！充実したツールを使って、自分だけの3Dコインをデザインできます。

リアルな物理演算と振動フィードバック
スムーズな3Dアニメーション、本物のような効果音、そして振動でリアルな感触を再現。勝利を祝う紙吹雪エフェクトも搭載！

履歴と統計機能
カウンター機能と詳細な履歴ログで、これまでの結果をいつでも確認できます。

洗練されたモダンなデザイン
ダークモードとライトモードに対応し、昼夜を問わず快適に使用できます。

今すぐ《コイントス - 表か裏か決めるアプリ》をダウンロードして、新しいコイントス体験をはじめましょう！
ja.releaseNotes:
2.2.7 の新機能

投げる音を選べるように
• 3種類から選べます：クラシック、メタリック、響くコイン
• 設定 → 投げる音 で、タップして試聴できます
• 選んだ音は Apple Watch でも鳴ります

本物のコインのような音
• 投げ方で音が変わります：やさしく弾くと控えめに、強く弾くと明るく大きく
• 同じ音は二度と鳴りません

de.description:
Triff schnelle und faire Entscheidungen mit nur einem Wisch – jetzt auch in Augmented Reality!

Kopf oder Zahl gewinnt bringt das klassische Münzwerfen auf ein völlig neues Level. Egal ob für spontane Alltagsfragen, Spieleabende oder Entscheidungen in der Gruppe: Die App liefert dir ein 100% zufälliges Ergebnis im modernen Design.

DAS ERWARTET DICH:

MÜNZWURF IN AR (AUGMENTED REALITY)
Wirf deine Münze über die Kamera direkt in deine echte Umgebung und betrachte 3D-Münzen hautnah in deinem Raum.

MINISPIEL: MÜNZ-PONG
Platziere virtuelle Gläser auf deinem echten Tisch und beweise dein Geschick beim AR-Münz-Pong – oder spiele das Minispiel ganz klassisch ohne Kamera.

EIGENER MÜNZ-EDITOR
Gestalte deine eigenen 3D-Münzen mit individuellen Designs, Details und Werkzeugen.

REALISTISCHES FEELING
Flüssige Animationen, echte Soundeffekte, spürbares haptisches Feedback und optionaler Konfetti-Effekt bei Gewinnen.

ÜBERSICHT & STATISTIKEN
Behalte mit der integrierten Wurfhistorie und dem Ergebniszähler jederzeit den Überblick über deine Würfe.

MODERNES DESIGN
Vollständige Unterstützung für Dark- und Light-Mode für eine angenehme Nutzung zu jeder Tageszeit.

Lade dir Kopf oder Zahl gewinnt herunter und hole dir das ultimative Münzwurf-Erlebnis direkt auf dein Smartphone!
de.releaseNotes:
Neu in 2.2.7

Wähle deinen Wurfton
• Drei Töne zur Auswahl: Klassisch, Metallisch und Klingende Münze
• Zu finden unter Einstellungen → Wurfton, mit Vorhören per Tipp
• Dein Ton klingt auch auf der Apple Watch

Klingt wie eine echte Münze
• Der Ton passt sich deinem Wurf an: sanft geschnippt leiser, kräftig geschnippt heller und lauter
• Kein Wurf klingt genau wie der andere

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Game Mode: Guess the Next Coin
Choose Heads or Tails before the flip and test your intuition. The app instantly shows whether your guess was correct, including a results overview.
	•	⌚ Apple Watch App
Now available directly on the Apple Watch. Flip the coin with a swipe or the Digital Crown, featuring smooth animations, sound, and haptic feedback.

What’s New in This Version
	•	General bug fixes and performance improvements.
	•	Enhancements to the Apple Watch version for a smoother and more reliable experience.

What’s New in This Version
Expanded Language Support: The app is now available in additional languages.

Stability Package: Bug fixes and general performance optimizations for both iOS and watchOS.

Firebase Integration: Implementation of Google Firebase for technical app optimization and analytics.

UI Improvements: Minor adjustments for a faster and more stable user experience.

In Version 2.0 we completely redesigned the app:
 • Brand new design
 • New Game Center — Guess the Coin & Battle Mode
 • iMessage Extension — flip the coin directly in chat
 • Apple Watch — optimized and improved
 • Gold Coin & Custom Coin with your own photo
 • Onboarding for new users
 • Many small improvements and bug fixes
The coin picker now shows both sides of every coin at a glance – making it easier to find your favourite.

AI Duel — Challenge a digital opponent, collect points, and rise from Bronze to Diamond in the league.
Share Result — Share your coin flip with friends right after the result.

• New Duel Mode: Completely redesigned – cleaner, smoother, and more intuitive.
• Bug Fixes: Optimised stability and improved under-the-hood performance.

BRING THE COIN FLIP INTO YOUR ROOM!

With this update, Augmented Reality (AR), new minigames, and even more customization options arrive in the app:

Coin Flip in Augmented Reality (AR)
Toss your coin via the camera directly into your real environment. View your own 3D creations and all standard coins up close in your space.

AR Coin Pong & Classic Mode
- AR Pong: Place virtual glasses on your real table and sink the coin!
- Classic: Play Coin Pong as usual without using the camera.

Expanded Coin Editor
Design your custom coins with even more details and tools.

New Animations & Sound
Fresh flip effects and redesigned, more realistic sounds.

Performance & Bug Fixes
Better performance, faster loading, and many small bug fixes for a smoother experience.

Enjoying the update? We’d love a quick review on the App Store!

This update fixes the rings on your own coins.

• The photo used to spill past the ring — now it sits neatly inside.
• The ring was missing in Coin Pong, in the AI Duel, in the coin picker and on the card you share. It shows up everywhere now.
• New: your ring now appears on the 3D coin in AR and Coin Pong as well.
• In the coin picker the two sides were stuck together.
• The ring is correct in iMessage again.

Ready for the new iPhone Duo – fine-tuned for both folded and unfolded use.

• AR Coin Pong now keeps your personal best score.
• Coin Pong is easier to read in light mode, and your music keeps playing while you play.
• Plus lots of small fixes and improvements, including on iPad and in iMessage.

• Name heads and tails: press and hold the coin to turn heads into "Pizza" and tails into "Sushi". Your pairs are saved.
• Press Space to flip on Mac and on iPad with a keyboard.
• Try the gold coin 3 times for free.
• New one-time tips for beginners instead of a hint on every launch.
• Small improvements and bug fixes.

New in 2.2.6

Widgets for iPhone and iPad
• Flip the coin right from your Home Screen, without opening the app
• Also on your Lock Screen
• New button for Control Center and the Action Button: press it and the coin flies

Apple Watch
• Heads or Tails on your watch face and in the Smart Stack. One tap and the coin flies
• Your own labels now on your watch too, synced with your iPhone
• New, clear coin picker as a list
• Feel the result: heads taps once, tails taps twice

New in 2.2.7

Choose your flip sound
• Three sounds to pick from: Classic, Metallic and Ringing Coin
• Find them under Settings → Flip Sound, tap to preview
• Your sound also plays on Apple Watch

Sounds like a real coin
• The sound follows your flick: a gentle flick sounds softer, a strong one brighter and louder
• No two flips sound exactly the same
